detail: Full summary: The switchboard's N-CONFLICT control was silently vacuous-adjacent before this: it reported a projection defect (superseded instead of conflicted) when the real cause was that half the fixture never got admitted. A control that fails for the wrong reason is as misleading as one that cannot fail.
